notes: Tax Code of Georgia (matsne, art. 166): VAT rate 18%; no investment-gold exemption in the Code, so bullion and jewellery pay 18%. NBG gold-bar certificates, 27 Nov 2026: 20 g buy 5,785.32 / sell 6,262.46 GEL; 1,000 g buy 289,265.80 / sell 313,122.77 - 7.6% buyback discount at both sizes. No primary spot, premiums empty; duty null.
